boards.title: Claimed by 9am: 10 Study Spots Worth Showing Up Early For
boards.description: Ten named URI study environments with source-backed access and workspace details.

cards.title: 24-Hour Study Room
cards.subtitle: Carothers Library, first floor
cards.notes: Bring your URI ID for the card-swipe entrance after 11 p.m.; check out any library materials before using them there overnight.
cards.short_summary: An academic-year overnight room with URI-ID access after library closing.
cards.evidence_claim: URI states that the room is open every night during the academic year, including weekends, and requires URI-ID card swipe access after 11 p.m.
cards.access_notes: During the academic year it is open nightly, including weekends. Access is through the library until 11 p.m.; after that, use the brown-door card swipe with a URI ID.

cards.title: Graduate Research/Study Carrels
cards.subtitle: Carothers Library, second and third floors
cards.notes: If you are completing graduate research, dissertation, or thesis work, ask the Circulation Desk about requesting an individual carrel.
cards.short_summary: Individual carrels designated for qualifying graduate research projects.
cards.evidence_claim: URI identifies these individual carrels for graduate students doing dissertations, theses, or graduate-program research and directs requests to Circulation.
cards.access_notes: Designed for graduate students whose dissertations, theses, or research projects require library accessibility; request use at the Circulation Desk.

cards.title: University Library Group Study Rooms
cards.subtitle: Carothers Library, lower level through third floor
cards.notes: Use the library’s online booking route to reserve a room, then confirm its floor and any current access directions before your session.
cards.short_summary: Bookable group rooms distributed across four library levels.
cards.evidence_claim: URI lists group study rooms on the lower level and floors 1–3 of the Kingston University Library and provides an online booking system.
cards.access_notes: Located on the Lower Level and Floors 1–3 of the Kingston University Library; use the library’s online booking system to reserve.

cards.title: Learning Commons
cards.subtitle: Carothers Library, first floor
cards.notes: Set up here when your work needs conversation or screen sharing; the space includes group study rooms with shared monitors and research help.
cards.short_summary: A collaborative first-floor workspace with shared-monitor rooms and research assistance.
cards.evidence_claim: URI describes the Learning Commons as a collaborative work and study space and says its group rooms have shared monitors for project collaboration.
cards.access_notes: Located on the first floor in the library directory. Professional librarians and graduate library-school students provide research help there.

cards.title: Galanti Lounge
cards.subtitle: Carothers Library, third floor
cards.notes: Check the lounge calendar before planning a group work session, since URI says groups may reserve it for short-term scholarly or cultural activities.
cards.short_summary: A reservable third-floor lounge for short-term scholarly group use.
cards.evidence_claim: URI says Galanti Lounge is a third-floor University Library meeting space that groups may reserve for short-term scholarly, cultural, or special University activities.
cards.access_notes: Third-floor University Library meeting space; group reservations are for short-term scholarly, cultural, or special University activities.

cards.title: Living/Learning Room
cards.subtitle: Ranger Hall, Harrington School
cards.notes: Bring a laptop and charger for a flexible study break: URI lists outlets in the furniture, charging stations, and monitors with HDMI connections.
cards.short_summary: An open Ranger Hall room with soft seating, charging, and display connections.
cards.evidence_claim: URI describes Ranger Hall’s Living/Learning Room as an open space for relaxing, meeting, and studying, with charging stations, outlets, and three HDMI-capable monitors.
cards.source_title: Labs and Study Spaces – Harrington School of Communication and Media
cards.access_notes: The room is in Ranger Hall. URI lists comfortable furniture, charging stations, furniture outlets, and three HDMI-connected monitors.

cards.title: Bill Achtmeyer Collaborative Editing Suite
cards.subtitle: Ranger Hall, rooms 108 and 110
cards.notes: Reserve through the Media Equipment Center for a three-hour block when your project needs a shared monitor, whiteboards, and a private team room.
cards.short_summary: A reservable private collaborative room with screens, whiteboards, and editing tools.
cards.evidence_claim: URI describes the Bill Achtmeyer Collaborative Editing Suite and Collaborative Editing Suite #2 as private collaborative work rooms with six-person seating, a monitor, whiteboards, and three-hour student reservations.
cards.source_title: Labs and Study Spaces – Harrington School of Communication and Media
cards.access_notes: Rooms 108 and 110 can be reserved by students in three-hour blocks, up to two weeks ahead, through the Media Equipment Center.

cards.title: Computer Science Student Lounge
cards.subtitle: Computer Science Lab Complex
cards.notes: Use the lounge for focused laptop work between classes; URI lists Wi-Fi, power outlets, and two whiteboards for discussion or problem-solving.
cards.short_summary: A quiet student lounge with Wi-Fi, power, and whiteboards.
cards.evidence_claim: URI describes the Computer Science Student Lounge as a large open area where students can work quietly between classes, with Wi-Fi, outlets, and two whiteboards.
cards.source_title: Facilities – Department of Computer Science and Statistics
cards.access_notes: Located outside the Computer Science Lab Complex; URI specifically identifies it as a student work area between classes.

cards.title: Computer Science Lab Complex
cards.subtitle: URI Department of Computer Science and Statistics
cards.notes: Choose this setting for laptop-based problem solving or a project meeting; the complex includes computer classrooms, meeting rooms, a lounge, and extra outlets.
cards.short_summary: A department hub with computer classrooms, meeting rooms, a lounge, and laptop power.
cards.evidence_claim: URI says the Computer Science Lab Complex contains two large computer classrooms, two meeting rooms, and a student lounge, with extra outlets to support laptop work.
cards.source_title: Facilities – Department of Computer Science and Statistics
cards.access_notes: URI calls the complex the department’s main facility and meeting place; it supports laptop work in labs, meeting rooms, and its lounge area.

cards.title: Catholic Center Library
cards.subtitle: Catholic Center, 90 Chapel Way
cards.notes: Use the quiet-study library during posted building hours, and plan around school vacations when the center is closed.
cards.short_summary: A quiet-study library inside URI’s Catholic Center.
cards.evidence_claim: URI lists a library for quiet study among the Catholic Center’s facilities and posts building hours plus school-vacation closure information.
cards.source_title: Catholic Center – Religious Life at URI
cards.access_notes: Posted hours are Sunday–Thursday 8 a.m.–10 p.m. and Friday 8 a.m.–5 p.m.; the center is closed during school vacations.
